segments.name: Net leased properties
segments.description: Acquires, leases, finances and owns net-leased properties with frontage, leased to diversified tenants.
segments.evidence: The Company currently operates in a single reportable segment, which includes the acquisition, leasing, mortgage loan financing and ownership of net leased properties.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under net leases and generally cover real estate taxes, insurance and maintenance of the property.
revenueModel.evidence: The leases are generally net leases, where the tenants are generally responsible for the payment of real estate taxes, insurance premiums and maintenance costs related to the leased property.
